title: Coda Reservoir
hook: Hear a 12-qubit reservoir click like a sperm whale.
sub: A quantum reservoir learned the rhythms of 3,840 real codas recorded off Dominica. Play the whales, then let the reservoir carry on.
you_control: Pick real codas, the reservoir, or the real-to-reservoir handoff, or tap a whale in the sea
Choose a whale label, or a variation level and take (each a real qrc-gen-v2 job)
Play, pause, scrub and slow down; each click lights its whale's head and sends out a ring
qubits_note: 12 reservoir qubits (num_qubits, set at training and reused by every qrc-gen-v2 job); the engine maximum, 13 is rejected with HTTP 422
honesty: Rhythm only: no meaning is claimed; codas are treated as rhythm tokens. Reservoir ran on Atlas's Aer simulator; tokenising, timing and click synthesis are classical.
